sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.title: Scroll & Custom Tooltip Dimensions
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.max_width_: Maximum percentage of the Minecraft window allowed as the §6Tooltip Width§r.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.max_height: Maximum percentage of the Minecraft window allowed as the §6Tooltip Height§r.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.enable_cus: Enables setting §6custom maximum dimensions§r for tooltips and §6tooltip scrolling§r.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.title_over:
Selects the behavior if the hovered item's name is larger than the maximum width of a Tooltip.

§6Wrap:§r Wraps the name (separates it in multiple lines)
§6Truncate:§r Truncates the name to the maximum tooltip width and adds '...' at the end.
§6Horizontal Scroll:§r Smoothly scrolls the text horizontally forwards and then backwards to show the entire name in a single line.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.enable_tit: If enabled, automatically centers the §6item title§r horizontally within the tooltip space.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.title_scro: Adjusts the speed of the horizontal scrolling text animation when §6Title Overflow Mode§r is set to §6Horizontal Scroll§r.
The pause duration in milliseconds before and after horizontal title scrolling when §6Title Overflow Mode§r is set to §6Horizontal Scroll§r.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.lock_conta: If scrolling in different containers simultaneously is locked or disabled. This prevents scrolling a tooltip while in the creative menu for example. If disabled, both scroll at the same time.
§4§lWarning:§r §cYou probably don't want to disable this.§r
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.scroll_smo:
Adjusts the smoothness of the tooltip scroll animation.

§60.00§r: Instant scroll (no animation)
§61.00§r: Maximum smoothness
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.scroll_eas:
Selects the animation style used when scrolling through tooltips.

§6Classic:§r Constant scrolling speed.
§6Smooth:§r Natural scrolling with soft deceleration.
§6Snappy:§r Quick and responsive scrolling.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.lines_per_: The number of lines scrolled vertically with each turn of the mouse wheel.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.obscure_co: Enables dynamic dimensions, pinned headers, item model support, and smooth scrolling compatibility with §6Obscure Tooltips§r.
sts.tooltip_dimensions_screen.tooltip_ov: Enables dynamic dimensions, pinned headers, item model support, and smooth scrolling compatibility with §6Tooltip Overhaul§r.
